# Jaypore Labs — Enterprise software architecture & engineering

> Jaypore Labs helps organizations design, modernize and integrate the systems they run on. Senior architects and engineers, accountable from strategy to operations. Since 2017. Headquartered in India; clients across North America, Europe, the Middle East and APAC.

## Solutions
- [Architecture Assessment](https://jayporelabs.com/solutions#architecture-assessment): current-state review, target architecture and a phased roadmap (1–2 weeks)
- [Legacy Modernization](https://jayporelabs.com/solutions#legacy-modernization): phased replacement of legacy platforms without a big-bang rewrite
- [Systems Integration](https://jayporelabs.com/solutions#systems-integration): one operational picture across ERP, CRM and line-of-business systems
- [Enterprise Application Delivery](https://jayporelabs.com/solutions#enterprise-applications): portals and business-critical applications, first production release in 8–12 weeks
- [Applied AI & Automation](https://jayporelabs.com/solutions#applied-ai): document processing, enterprise search and workflow automation with governance and human review
- [Managed Engineering & Support](https://jayporelabs.com/solutions#managed-engineering): operation, support and continuous improvement after go-live

## Services
- [Services overview](https://jayporelabs.com/services): Enterprise Architecture, Enterprise Applications, Modernization & Integration, Digital Platform Engineering, Desktop & Field Applications, Applied AI & Automation

## Engagement models
- Program delivery — defined scope, milestones and governance
- Dedicated team — a stable, cross-functional team over multiple quarters
- Capacity extension — senior architects and engineers embedded in client teams
